proves.claim: The thin status door returns null on a board with landing, relay, runner, health, job or verify-proof records, and on no board, drift, ReadNeedsWrite or schemaMissing.

cli.io-status-thin.steps-aside.why: Without it, a regression where the thin status door served a board whose full status prints sections the door cannot would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The thin status door returns null when the board refuses the read as a write refusal.

cli.io-status-thin.write-refused.why: Without it, a regression where a write refusal reached the caller instead of the full path would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: status calls the thin door first only when readThinCommands() is true, loads no thin module when it is off, and prints the same lines either way.

cli.io-status-thin.wired-behind-setting.why: Without it, a regression where status loaded the thin door with the setting off, or changed its output with it on, would pass unnoticed.
